scripts.dev: npm run build -w @livekit-app/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,desktop -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @livekit-app/shared" "npm run dev -w @livekit-app/server" "npm run dev -w @livekit-app/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @livekit-app/shared && npm run build -w @livekit-app/server -w @livekit-app/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @livekit-app/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
